title: Noughts and Crosses: Who Won?
story: The board is a 9 character string like "XOX.O.X.." (dots are empty). Read it row by row.
goal: Write winner(board): return "X" or "O" if that player has three in a row, column or diagonal, otherwise None.
hints: There are only eight lines to check. They are listed for you in LINES.
Loop over LINES. A line wins when all three cells are equal and not empty (".").
socratic: Why must you ignore three dots in a row?
How can one loop cover rows, columns and diagonals?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Noughts and Crosses: Who Won?”?
